title: 200 response of POST /api/iam/token and POST /api/iam/token/refresh
description: RFC 8693 section 2.2.1 (token exchange) and RFC 6749 section 5.1 (refresh). Sent with Cache-Control: no-store. refresh_token is present after a login exchange and a refresh, absent after a delegation exchange (reserved) and a client-credentials grant (reserved).

refresh_expires_in.description: Seconds until the session's absolute end.
